grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings exceed the C-grade threshold (max_p1: 2). 3 are critical CVSS 9.8 CVEs; 1 is a tooling gap causing false-green CI coverage.

escalations.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Execution (GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp)
escalations.description: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary files can be read and executed without authentication
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker on the same network as a dev/CI server with Vitest UI exposed can read .env files, private keys, and execute arbitrary code
escalations.fix: npm install vitest@latest in Source/Frontend; npm update vitest in portal/Backend, platform/orchestrator

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (GHSA-xq3m-2v4x-88gg)
escalations.description: Arbitrary code execution when parsing untrusted .proto files or JSON with protobufjs
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends malformed .proto payload to any portal/Backend endpoint that deserializes protocol buffers, achieving remote code execution
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs in portal/Backend; audit all .proto deserialization endpoints

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection RCE (GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q + 7 additional CVEs)
escalations.description: 8 distinct RCE vectors via AST type confusion including @partial-block, dynamic partial injection, prototype pollution, and CLI precompiler injection
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends crafted template data to any Source/Backend route that renders Handlebars templates with user-controlled input; escapes sandbox via AST type confusion to execute arbitrary server-side code
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars in Source/Backend; audit all template-rendering calls for user-controlled template source

findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to 7 of 8 active plans
findings.description: Auto-fallback selects most-recently-modified requirements.md; 7 plans including 103 FRs silently unchecked. CI reports false PASSED.
findings.recommendation: Iterate all Plans/*/requirements.md files and aggregate results, or add plans.active list to inspector.config.yml

findings.title: Direct store access from route handlers
findings.description: Route handlers call store.* directly. CLAUDE.md prohibits direct DB/store calls from routes; service layer required.
findings.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts; move all store calls and validation into service functions; route handlers call service only

findings.title: Logger lacks NODE_ENV-aware formatting and LOG_LEVEL support
findings.description: Always emits JSON regardless of NODE_ENV. LOG_LEVEL env var documented in CLAUDE.md but never read. Two logger interfaces exist (shim + impl).
findings.recommendation: Add NODE_ENV check for pretty-print in dev; honour LOG_LEVEL; consolidate to one logger entry point (delete compat shim src/logger.ts)

findings.title: OpenTelemetry tracing not implemented (FR-WF-013)
findings.description: No @opentelemetry packages installed. No traceId/spanId in logs. No traceparent header handling. FR-WF-013 AC explicitly requires this.
findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node and auto-instrumentations; initialize before app.listen(); inject traceId/spanId in log entries; add traceparent propagation middleware

findings.title: Domain spec FR-001 to FR-069 orphaned from Source/ (structural misalignment)
findings.description: 69 FRs describe portal/ product (SQLite feature-request/bug/cycle system). CLAUDE.md incorrectly describes portal/ as 'Debug portal UI'. Zero Verifies: FR-XXX comments for these IDs in Source/.
findings.recommendation: Update CLAUDE.md module table; create Specifications/self-judging-workflow-engine.md for Source/; retire or redirect dev-workflow-platform.md

findings.title: Brace-Expansion DoS (GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp)
findings.description: Process hang and memory exhaustion via exponential-time expansion of consecutive {} groups

findings.title: Form-Data Header Injection
findings.description: Unsafe multipart form data header handling allows arbitrary header injection

findings.title: js-yaml Code Execution (unsafe YAML parsing)
findings.description: Unsafe YAML parsing can lead to code execution when parsing untrusted input
findings.fix: npm update js-yaml; ensure yaml.load() never parses untrusted input without safe mode

findings.title: Vite Dev Server SSRF (<5.4.0)
findings.description: Vite dev server vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery; attackers can route requests to internal networks

findings.title: Postcss ReDoS in CSS Parsing
findings.description: ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service) in CSS parsing via malicious CSS input

findings.title: Nanoid Missing Entropy (Predictable IDs)
findings.description: Weak random number generation in certain configurations; generated IDs are predictable

findings.title: React Router Open Redirect (GHSA-2j2x-hqr9-3h42)
findings.description: Same-origin redirect validation bypass via protocol-relative URL reinterpretation; attackers redirect users to arbitrary domains

findings.title: Body-Parser Request Size Validation Bypass (<1.20.6)
findings.description: Invalid limit value silently disables size enforcement; can allow unbounded request sizes causing DoS

findings.title: Express Middleware Chain Vulnerability (<4.22.2)
findings.description: Middleware chain bypass or authentication escape possible in certain configurations

findings.title: QS Query String Prototype Pollution
findings.description: Prototype pollution or injection in query string parsing; potential object pollution in edge cases

findings.title: Duplicate logger abstraction (compat shim)
findings.description: src/logger.ts is a compat shim wrapping utils/logger.ts with different interface. Two logger paths, one log sink.
findings.recommendation: Normalize utils/logger.ts signature, delete src/logger.ts, update all imports

findings.title: Dependency-linking implementation delta is stale
findings.description: Delta marks 3 items as missing but they exist. References portal/ paths for items implemented in Source/.
findings.recommendation: Remove or automate the Implementation Delta section; use enforcer as authoritative source

findings.title: Two eslint-disable suppressions without explanation
findings.description: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed without comments explaining why dep omission is safe. Potential stale closure bugs.
findings.recommendation: Add missing deps or add explanatory comment for each suppression

findings.title: Express 4.18.2 → 5.2.1 (1 major behind)
findings.fix: npm update express@4 (to 4.22.2) or npm install express@5

findings.title: Pino 8.17.0 → 10.3.1 (2 majors behind)
findings.fix: npm update pino (test for API changes)

findings.title: React 18.3.1 → 19.2.8 (1 major behind)
findings.fix: npm install react@19 react-dom@19 (requires component review)

findings.title: Excessive transitive dependencies in portal/Backend (577 packages)
findings.description: 577 transitive deps driven by @opentelemetry/* suite, gRPC ecosystem, and Google Cloud SDKs. Increases supply-chain attack surface.
findings.recommendation: Audit OpenTelemetry usage; lazy-load or move unused packages to optional dependencies; document observability architecture

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Implement OTel in Source/Backend with NODE_ENV-aware logging in one PR

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Product Split Not Reflected in Tooling & Docs
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Fix enforcer + update CLAUDE.md + create self-judging-workflow-engine.md in one solo-session PR
Delete compat shim, normalize utils/logger.ts, add NODE_ENV and LOG_LEVEL support

next_audit.conditions: Run with live services (backend :3001, frontend :5173) for performance-profiler and chaos-monkey dynamic mode
next_audit.expected_improvement: Grade C or better if P1 CVEs patched and QO-001 enforcer fixed
